items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: my uncle’s name was Burrill B. Crohn

ctx.x: It’s an interesting outlook. Because I know you have medical — your uncle was very well known, right?

My name is Burrill L. Crohn and my uncle’s name was Burrill B. Crohn, and he is the — not the inventor but he correctly identified the cluster of symptoms as being misdiagnosed as Crohn’s disease. And so yeah, so I bear that name, which is interesting. There is a connection there somehow. Everyone thought I should be a doctor and I wasn’t interested, but I am interested in healing.
So what’s the best circumstances you’ve ever been shooting at — the most — like everything came together. I mean I know what I thought.
